# BigQuery neither compares nor orders ARRAYs, whatever their elements, even inside STRUCTs.

SELECT [1, NULL] = [1, NULL]
=> error contains: Equality is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT [1, NULL] != [1, NULL]
=> error contains: Inequality is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>) = [1]
=> error contains: Equality is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT [STRUCT(x, CAST(NULL AS INT64))] = [STRUCT(1, CAST(NULL AS INT64))] FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error contains: Equality is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<STRUCT<x INT64, INT64>>

SELECT [x] = [x] FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> error contains: Equality is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<DOUBLE>

SELECT [1, 2] < [1, 3]
=> error contains: Less than is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT [1, 2] > [1, NULL]
=> error contains: Greater than is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT GREATEST([1, 2], [1, 3])
=> error contains: GREATEST is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT LEAST([1, NULL], [2])
=> error contains: LEAST is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT MAX(a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1, 2] AS a), STRUCT([1, 3] AS a)])
=> error contains: MAX is not defined for arguments of type ARRAY<INT64>

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1, 2] AS a), STRUCT([1] AS a)]) ORDER BY a LIMIT 1
=> error contains: ORDER BY does not support expressions of type ARRAY<INT64>

# BigQuery groups by ARRAYs but rejects them in aggregate functions with DISTINCT.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([1, 2] AS a), STRUCT([1, 2] AS a)])
=> error contains: Aggregate functions with DISTINCT cannot be used with arguments of type ARRAY
